promptEs: Escuchá el compás de 4/4 y elegí la secuencia de duraciones que corresponde.
promptEn: Listen to the 4/4 measure and choose the sequence of durations that matches.
explanationEs: El patrón tiene una blanca, dos corcheas y una negra: 2 + 0,5 + 0,5 + 1 = 4 tiempos. La blanca ocupa los dos primeros tiempos y la negra el último.
explanationEn: The pattern has a half note, two eighth notes, and a quarter note: 2 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 1 = 4 beats. The half note takes the first two beats and the quarter note the last one.
choicesEn: Half note, Eighth note, Eighth note, Quarter note
Half note, Eighth note, Quarter note, Eighth note
Quarter note, Eighth note, Eighth note, Half note
Eighth note, Eighth note, Half note, Quarter note
